notes.title: NORR: Will Walker release date announced
notes.notes:
Launching August, 2021, Will Walker introduces new exciting story, crazy characters and insane top-down bullethell gameplay with slow-mo and lots of blood.

And now here comes the trailer!

[previewyoutube=tgx_CNdD2TM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: UPDATE: MULTIPLAYER AND EVENTS!
notes.notes:
[h1]Our team is glad to introduce you new online features![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/1b5258d9618f98831d192962e71baa113746bf25.png[/img]

[b]MULTIPLAYER UPDATE[/b]

[i]We are pleased to inform you that from now multiplayer will be available in the game!
It will be expanded and maintained in the future. Stay with us![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/7afcaeaf72d291912ecbf9a76a08ac32248fd1fb.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/f806111b28548123136ca6ef5bfed4e4fb6eb82f.png[/img]





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/7a1567c3b8cd568e707417405254f111cc7bf0ab.png[/img]

[b]EVENTS UPDATE[/b]

[i]Our team is pleased to present you a new game mechanics! Events!
Special levels available for passing only in certain seasons.
Did you find the story mode and survival too simple?
Then events are exactly what you need![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35368970/b014d7e92c0aef0918948acdc824be4816835bc2.png[/img]
